tasks.subject: Task 1: Replication keep-alive ping with netlog (M9 Task 60, moved)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A peer session whose link froze or whose peer stops answering ends within `peerPing + peerPingTimeout`

**Verify:** `cd ~/Documents/Projects/OttterMSG/otter-server-0b && go test ./internal/replication/ -run 'Keepalive' -count=3 -race` → `ok`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server/internal/replication/session.go", "otter-server/internal/replication/replicator.go", "otter-server/internal/replication/keepalive_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "`cd ~/Documents/Projects/OttterMSG/otter-server-0b && go test ./internal/replication/ -run 'Keepalive' -count=3 -race` \u2192 `ok`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["A session over a connection that stops reading and writing ends on both nodes within `peerPing + peerPingTimeout`.", "Each node that noticed writes a netlog entry `Endpoint \"ping\"`, `Class timeout`, direction `out` on the dialer, `in` on the acceptor.", "A healthy session survives \u2265 10 ping intervals (same `*session`).", "After the drop the nodes reconnect (a new session object appears)."]}
```
